`npx agents tui <url>` opens a chat client in your terminal and connects it to one conversation's Web Channel on an agent. It was added in agents 0.27.0, the version this project has installed. You pass it the Web Channel URL. Plain `http(s)` URLs work too, because the tool switches them to `ws(s)` and talks to the agent over a WebSocket.

- **Slash commands:** if the agent supports them, you can use `/new`, `/fork`, `/reset [note]`, `/conversations` and `/switch <id>` to start, branch, restart, list or move between conversations.
- **Options:** `--as` sets the `as` query parameter, which demo agents read as the participant's name. `--header` (or `-H`) adds a header to the WebSocket connection request, and you can repeat it.
- **Cloudflare Access:** if the URL is behind Access, it gets a token from `cloudflared`, which opens a browser login the first time. Or you can set `CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID` and `CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET` to send a service token instead.

I checked all of this against the help text in the installed `node_modules/agents/dist/cli.js`.
